::: {.column width="60%"}

Inferential Models (IMs) are originated from the book, as seen here, by Ryan Martin and Chuanhai Liu from 2015. It provides a tool outside the Frequentist and Bayesian frameworks that offers the capability of uncertainty quantification and reliability guarantee. While the construction from 2015 relies on random set theory, more recent constructions are based on possibility theory and arguably easier to use. Up till now, the introduction of IMs almost solely rely on publications, which by their nature have to be concise. This website intends to provide general information not delivered by publications, such as tutorials, toy examples, recent updates, etc. 

:::
